partition_policy.training: all target facts except source-exclusive validation and blind facts

results.name: Shared inhibited-target drug-peer transfer
results.hypothesis: An unlabeled drug can inherit an indication from a non-blind treated peer when both drugs directly bind and decrease the same causal disease target.
results.body: candidate and training-treated peer share a directly bound, decreased causal disease gene
results.mechanism_rationale: The rule transfers an indication through an identical directional target mechanism, but shared target action does not guarantee equivalent exposure or therapeutic context.
results.trapi_notes: The positive peer, target, and disease paths are TRAPI-expressible; source exclusion, drug distinctness, and ontology constraints require post-processing.
results.cypher:
MATCH (peer:Drug)-[treatment:TREATS|AMELIORATES_CONDITION]->(object:Disease)
WHERE any(
  source IN coalesce(treatment.primary_knowledge_sources, [])
  WHERE NOT source IN ['infores:drug-repurposing-hub', 'infores:ttd']
)
MATCH (peer)-[:DIRECTLY_PHYSICALLY_INTERACTS_WITH]->(gene:Gene)
MATCH (peer)-[peer_effect:AFFECTS]->(gene)
MATCH (subject:Drug)-[:DIRECTLY_PHYSICALLY_INTERACTS_WITH]->(gene)
MATCH (subject)-[subject_effect:AFFECTS]->(gene)
MATCH (gene)-[:MINER_GENE_DISEASE_EVIDENCE]->(object)
WHERE subject <> peer
  AND peer_effect.qualified_predicate = 'biolink:causes'
  AND peer_effect.object_aspect_qualifier = 'activity_or_abundance'
  AND peer_effect.object_direction_qualifier = 'decreased'
  AND subject_effect.qualified_predicate = 'biolink:causes'
  AND subject_effect.object_aspect_qualifier = 'activity_or_abundance'
  AND subject_effect.object_direction_qualifier = 'decreased'
  AND coalesce(object._miner_disease_descendant_degree, 0) <= 500
  AND object._miner_disease_superclass_degree >= 1
  AND object.id STARTS WITH 'MONDO:'
RETURN DISTINCT subject.id AS subject_id, object.id AS object_id

results.name: Chemical-class shared-target peer transfer
results.hypothesis: Shared-target indication transfer is more credible when candidate and treated peer also share a relatively specific chemical class.
results.body: R117 plus shared immediate chemical class containing at most 30 drugs
results.mechanism_rationale: The rule combines an identical directional target mechanism with chemical ontology similarity, but class membership is not a pharmacokinetic equivalence.
results.trapi_notes: The positive paths are TRAPI-expressible; source exclusion, shared-class identity, and class/ontology degree constraints require post-processing.

WHERE subject <> peer

results.name: Dual-shared-target drug-peer transfer
results.hypothesis: A candidate drug is more likely to share an indication when it and a treated peer both directly inhibit two causal disease targets.
results.body: candidate and training-treated peer share two distinct directly bound, decreased causal disease genes
results.mechanism_rationale: The rule transfers an indication through a two-target directional mechanism, but target activity direction in disease and drug exposure remain incomplete.
results.trapi_notes: The repeated positive paths are TRAPI-expressible; two-target cardinality, source exclusion, and ontology constraints require post-processing.
results.cypher:
MATCH (peer:Drug)-[treatment:TREATS|AMELIORATES_CONDITION]->(object:Disease)
WHERE any(
  source IN coalesce(treatment.primary_knowledge_sources, [])
  WHERE NOT source IN ['infores:drug-repurposing-hub', 'infores:ttd']
)
MATCH (peer)-[:DIRECTLY_PHYSICALLY_INTERACTS_WITH]->(gene1:Gene)
MATCH (peer)-[peer_effect1:AFFECTS]->(gene1)
MATCH (subject:Drug)-[:DIRECTLY_PHYSICALLY_INTERACTS_WITH]->(gene1)
MATCH (subject)-[subject_effect1:AFFECTS]->(gene1)
MATCH (gene1)-[:MINER_GENE_DISEASE_EVIDENCE]->(object)
MATCH (peer)-[:DIRECTLY_PHYSICALLY_INTERACTS_WITH]->(gene2:Gene)
MATCH (peer)-[peer_effect2:AFFECTS]->(gene2)
MATCH (subject)-[:DIRECTLY_PHYSICALLY_INTERACTS_WITH]->(gene2)
MATCH (subject)-[subject_effect2:AFFECTS]->(gene2)
MATCH (gene2)-[:MINER_GENE_DISEASE_EVIDENCE]->(object)
WHERE subject <> peer
  AND gene1.id < gene2.id
  AND peer_effect1.qualified_predicate = 'biolink:causes'
  AND peer_effect1.object_aspect_qualifier = 'activity_or_abundance'
  AND peer_effect1.object_direction_qualifier = 'decreased'
  AND subject_effect1.qualified_predicate = 'biolink:causes'
  AND subject_effect1.object_aspect_qualifier = 'activity_or_abundance'
  AND subject_effect1.object_direction_qualifier = 'decreased'
  AND peer_effect2.qualified_predicate = 'biolink:causes'
  AND peer_effect2.object_aspect_qualifier = 'activity_or_abundance'
  AND peer_effect2.object_direction_qualifier = 'decreased'
  AND subject_effect2.qualified_predicate = 'biolink:causes'
  AND subject_effect2.object_aspect_qualifier = 'activity_or_abundance'
  AND subject_effect2.object_direction_qualifier = 'decreased'
  AND coalesce(object._miner_disease_descendant_degree, 0) <= 500

results.name: Interacting causal-module drug-peer transfer
results.hypothesis: A candidate drug can inherit an indication when it inhibits a causal disease target that directly interacts with the causal target inhibited by a treated peer.
results.body: training-treated peer and candidate inhibit distinct interacting causal genes for the same disease
results.mechanism_rationale: The rule transfers across a molecularly connected causal module, but the unsigned interaction does not establish equivalent downstream consequences.
results.trapi_notes: The peer, target, interaction, and disease paths are TRAPI-expressible; source exclusion, target distinctness, and ontology constraints require post-processing.
results.cypher:
MATCH (peer:Drug)-[treatment:TREATS|AMELIORATES_CONDITION]->(object:Disease)
WHERE any(
  source IN coalesce(treatment.primary_knowledge_sources, [])
  WHERE NOT source IN ['infores:drug-repurposing-hub', 'infores:ttd']
)
MATCH (peer)-[:DIRECTLY_PHYSICALLY_INTERACTS_WITH]->(peer_gene:Gene)
MATCH (peer)-[peer_effect:AFFECTS]->(peer_gene)
MATCH (peer_gene)-[:MINER_GENE_DISEASE_EVIDENCE]->(object)
MATCH (subject:Drug)-[:DIRECTLY_PHYSICALLY_INTERACTS_WITH]->(subject_gene:Gene)
MATCH (subject)-[subject_effect:AFFECTS]->(subject_gene)
MATCH (subject_gene)-[:MINER_GENE_DISEASE_EVIDENCE]->(object)
MATCH (peer_gene)-[:DIRECTLY_PHYSICALLY_INTERACTS_WITH]-(subject_gene)
WHERE subject <> peer
  AND subject_gene <> peer_gene
  AND peer_effect.qualified_predicate = 'biolink:causes'
  AND peer_effect.object_aspect_qualifier = 'activity_or_abundance'
  AND peer_effect.object_direction_qualifier = 'decreased'
  AND subject_effect.qualified_predicate = 'biolink:causes'
  AND subject_effect.object_aspect_qualifier = 'activity_or_abundance'
  AND subject_effect.object_direction_qualifier = 'decreased'
  AND coalesce(object._miner_disease_descendant_degree, 0) <= 500
  AND object._miner_disease_superclass_degree >= 1
  AND object.id STARTS WITH 'MONDO:'
RETURN DISTINCT subject.id AS subject_id, object.id AS object_id

results.name: Tissue-localized interacting-module peer transfer
results.hypothesis: Interacting-target peer transfer is more credible when both causal targets are expressed in the same specific disease anatomy.
results.body: R120 plus Bgee expression of both targets in one disease anatomy with disease-location degree <=50
results.mechanism_rationale: The rule transfers across an interacting causal module localized to a disease tissue, but interaction direction and disease activity direction remain incomplete.
results.trapi_notes: The positive paths are TRAPI-expressible; source exclusion, shared anatomy identity, Bgee provenance, and degree constraints require post-processing.
results.cypher:
MATCH (peer:Drug)-[treatment:TREATS|AMELIORATES_CONDITION]->(object:Disease)
WHERE any(
  source IN coalesce(treatment.primary_knowledge_sources, [])
  WHERE NOT source IN ['infores:drug-repurposing-hub', 'infores:ttd']
)
MATCH (peer)-[:DIRECTLY_PHYSICALLY_INTERACTS_WITH]->(peer_gene:Gene)
MATCH (peer)-[peer_effect:AFFECTS]->(peer_gene)
MATCH (peer_gene)-[:MINER_GENE_DISEASE_EVIDENCE]->(object)
MATCH (subject:Drug)-[:DIRECTLY_PHYSICALLY_INTERACTS_WITH]->(subject_gene:Gene)
MATCH (subject)-[subject_effect:AFFECTS]->(subject_gene)
MATCH (subject_gene)-[:MINER_GENE_DISEASE_EVIDENCE]->(object)
MATCH (peer_gene)-[:DIRECTLY_PHYSICALLY_INTERACTS_WITH]-(subject_gene)
MATCH (peer_gene)-[peer_expression:EXPRESSED_IN]->(anatomy:AnatomicalEntity)
MATCH (subject_gene)-[subject_expression:EXPRESSED_IN]->(anatomy)
MATCH (object)-[:LOCATED_IN|OCCURS_IN]->(anatomy)
WHERE subject <> peer
  AND subject_gene <> peer_gene
  AND peer_effect.qualified_predicate = 'biolink:causes'
  AND peer_effect.object_aspect_qualifier = 'activity_or_abundance'
  AND peer_effect.object_direction_qualifier = 'decreased'
  AND subject_effect.qualified_predicate = 'biolink:causes'
  AND subject_effect.object_aspect_qualifier = 'activity_or_abundance'
  AND subject_effect.object_direction_qualifier = 'decreased'
  AND 'infores:bgee' IN coalesce(peer_expression.primary_knowledge_sources, [])
  AND 'infores:bgee' IN coalesce(subject_expression.primary_knowledge_sources, [])
  AND anatomy._miner_disease_location_degree <= 50
  AND coalesce(object._miner_disease_descendant_degree, 0) <= 500
  AND object._miner_disease_superclass_degree >= 1
  AND object.id STARTS WITH 'MONDO:'
RETURN DISTINCT subject.id AS subject_id, object.id AS object_id

results.name: Contradiction-gated shared-target peer transfer
results.hypothesis: Explicit adverse and opposite-direction evidence can remove false transfers between drugs sharing an inhibited causal target.
results.body: R117 excluding direct adverse disease edges, shared side-effect phenotypes, and opposite target-increase assertions
results.mechanism_rationale: The identical target mechanism is retained while graph-native evidence inconsistent with treatment is excluded.
results.trapi_notes: The positive paths are TRAPI-expressible; source exclusion and multiple NOT EXISTS gates require Cypher.
results.cypher:
MATCH (peer:Drug)-[treatment:TREATS|AMELIORATES_CONDITION]->(object:Disease)
WHERE any(
  source IN coalesce(treatment.primary_knowledge_sources, [])
  WHERE NOT source IN ['infores:drug-repurposing-hub', 'infores:ttd']
)
MATCH (peer)-[:DIRECTLY_PHYSICALLY_INTERACTS_WITH]->(gene:Gene)
MATCH (peer)-[peer_effect:AFFECTS]->(gene)
MATCH (subject:Drug)-[:DIRECTLY_PHYSICALLY_INTERACTS_WITH]->(gene)
MATCH (subject)-[subject_effect:AFFECTS]->(gene)
MATCH (gene)-[:MINER_GENE_DISEASE_EVIDENCE]->(object)
WHERE subject <> peer
  AND peer_effect.qualified_predicate = 'biolink:causes'
  AND peer_effect.object_aspect_qualifier = 'activity_or_abundance'
  AND peer_effect.object_direction_qualifier = 'decreased'
  AND subject_effect.qualified_predicate = 'biolink:causes'
  AND subject_effect.object_aspect_qualifier = 'activity_or_abundance'
  AND subject_effect.object_direction_qualifier = 'decreased'
  AND coalesce(object._miner_disease_descendant_degree, 0) <= 500
  AND object._miner_disease_superclass_degree >= 1
  AND object.id STARTS WITH 'MONDO:'
  AND NOT EXISTS {
    MATCH (subject)-[:CONTRAINDICATED_IN|EXACERBATES_CONDITION|CAUSES]->(object)
  }
  AND NOT EXISTS {
    MATCH (subject)-[:HAS_SIDE_EFFECT]->(:PhenotypicFeature)
          <-[:HAS_PHENOTYPE]-(object)
  }
  AND NOT EXISTS {
    MATCH (subject)-[opposite:AFFECTS]->(gene)
    WHERE opposite.qualified_predicate = 'biolink:causes'
      AND opposite.object_aspect_qualifier = 'activity_or_abundance'
      AND opposite.object_direction_qualifier = 'increased'
  }
RETURN DISTINCT subject.id AS subject_id, object.id AS object_id
